title: Well and Smile
author: Theo Reyes
blurb: Rafael Okafor, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
